main_text.head: EPILOGUS.
main_text.p: Satis superque Doctrina de febrib; Sex dictis elucescit; plura verò qui de[?] sideret, adeat Caput XXVII, & se[?] quentia de febribus praxeos Medic[?] Clarissimi & Experientissimi Viri D[?] Francisci de le Boe Sylvii Praxeo[?] Medicæ Professoris primarii; & bre[?] (annuente Divino Numine) tractulu[?] de febribus, hisce dictis fundamentis in[?] nitentem, studiosis Lectoribus dabimus.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of many lines; words marked [?] are incomplete at the edge. The initial S is a large decorated letter. The heading EPILOGUS and the word FINIS are set in spaced capitals.
